Venkata Subbamma

7780642391 | venkatasudhakurakula@gmail.com

Profile

Full-Stack Engineer with around 5 years of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications using Go, Node.js, React, and TypeScript. Specialized in designing RESTful APIs, event-driven systems with Apache Kafka, and RBAC permission IAM for secure, with strong expertise in MongoDB, MySQL PostgreSQL and backend system design. Experienced in developing modern frontend applications using TanStack (Router, Query), Redux, Zustand, and component libraries like Material UI and shadcn/ui for performant, type-safe user interfaces. Proficient in building containerized microservices with Docker, implementing end-to-end testing (Playwright, Vitest), and establishing observability using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. Actively learning on GenAI-powered applications using Python for data processing, workflow orchestration, and AI integrations.

Skills Summary

Languages : Web Development : Frameworks : Database: AI ML : Developer Tools : Testing : Libraries : DevOps : Observability :

Golang , JavaScript, Python HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Material UI, Tailwind CSS , shadcn, tanstack Gin , React, , Node, Express Js, REST API, Next.js , API Testing MySQL, MongoDB , PostgreeSQL RAG, OpenAI APIs, Embeddings,Gen AI Git, Postman ,Swagger, VS Code , Cursor jest, Cypress , Playwright Redux, React Router, Redux Toolkit , Tanstack , Zustand AWS, S3, SQS, Docker Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, , OpenTelemetry

Experience

Backend Developer Qylis Data | AI | Cyber Security

Mar 2025 – Present Hyderabad • Evaln, an enterprise-grade AI inference platform for on-premise and hybrid cloud deployments, spanning the evaln Infer plane (GPU gateway & node agents), control plane (IAM, orgs, marketplace, registry), and evaln-client web UI. Owned key modules end-to-end across API design, data modeling, and service integration, and contributed to architecture decisions on service boundaries, multi-tenant data flow, and deployment strategy.

Built backend services in Go (Gin) across evaln and AIBox microservices, including an inference API gateway (QGW), node-level GPU agent (QIA), and control-plane REST APIs with RBAC/IAM..

Delivered end-to-end product features in aibox-client using React + TypeScript (TanStack Router/Query, Zustand, Zod, shadcn/ui), connecting org, project, marketplace, and GPU resource workflows to AIBox APIs. Integrated OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana for distributed tracing and monitoring, and built a Playwright E2E framework to improve system visibility, reduce incident resolution time, and ensure repeatable cross-environment test coverage.

Software Engineer Nitya Software Solutions

Feb 2022 – Mar 2025 Hyderabad

Full-Stack Web Developer building scalable web applications using JavaScript, Python, React.js, Go, Node.js, Express, MySQL, MongoDB, and Mongoose; delivered end-to-end solutions including intuitive UI development with Material UI and seamless integration of external APIs.

Led the development of JobsnProfiles, a hiring platform serving employers, placement agencies, and job seekers in the US; contributed to a CRM application using React and Node.js to enhance customer relationship management.

Designed, implemented, and tested RESTful APIs for managing job listings, user profiles, and interactions using Postman; integrated AWS S3 and EC2 for scalable storage and deployment, improving performance, security, and system reliability.

Full Stack Developer Intern 10x Academy

May 2021 – Nov 2021 Hyderabad

Completed a structured full-stack development internship program at 10x Academy, building production-like applications using React, Node.js, and REST APIs, while also working with Golang for backend services. Gained hands-on experience across frontend and backend layers, implementing features, API integrations, and contributing to end-to-end system development.

Projects

Eval(n) | Go, Gin, React, PostgreSQL, Docker, Zustand, TanStack,

Mar 2025 – Present

Built and maintained Go-based microservices for an AI-driven inference platform (Evaln/AIBox), containerized with Docker Compose and deployed on Kubernetes, ensuring consistent environments.

Designed and implemented scalable RESTful APIs in Go (Gin) with clear contracts and modular architecture, incorporating structured error handling, and secure RBAC permissions IAM for multi-tenant access control.

Developed frontend features using React + TypeScript (TanStack Router/Query, Zustand, Zod, shadcn/ui), integrating efficiently with backend APIs to maintain data consistency and improve user experience across workflows.

Built and integrated an observability stack using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, enabling distributed tracing and monitoring to improve debugging, system visibility, and performance analysis across APIs and LLM workflows. • Developed an end-to-end testing framework with Playwright, using reusable utilities and JSON-based state

management to ensure reliable, maintainable, and repeatable test execution across environments.

Implemented event-driven architecture with Apache Kafka, handling message production and consumption with validation, retry mechanisms, and failure handling to ensure reliable asynchronous processing .

DevPulse | React,Node, TypeScript , Tanstack , PostgreSQL , AWS, REST APIs,

Feb 2026 –Present

Built DevPulse, an HR activity monitoring platform on Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL, and AWS S3, where a Windows PowerShell collector on employee machines sends hourly activity JSON via REST; full report payloads are stored in S3 using date-partitioned object keys while searchable metadata and dashboard indexes live in PostgreSQL.

Implemented a layered backend (handler → service → repository) with Snowflake IDs, report upserts enforced by a UNIQUE employee/time-window constraint, consistent typed HTTP errors, and async OpenAI security analysis decoupled from the upload response through background jobs.

Designed a hybrid AI scoring pipeline that combines deterministic URL/domain tagging (personal messaging, job-hunting, entertainment) with LLM-based risk scoring (risk level, risk score, structured findings[]), using prompts, JSON-mode responses, and server-side validation before persisting results.

Shipped a React (Vite) HR dashboard using MUI and TanStack Query, featuring employee and report views with S3-backed detail access, an AI risk panel with status polling and manual re-run, plus Docker Compose orchestration and a Windows collector deployment bundle (Task Scheduler, sqlite3).

JobsnProfiles | React, Golang, Express, Python, MySQL, Redux, Material UI, AWS, REST APIs

Feb 2022 – Mar 2025

JobsnProfiles is a full-stack hiring platform serving employers, placement agencies, and job seekers in the US, enabling end-to-end recruitment workflows at scale.

Architected a responsive React.js + Redux front-end with Material UI components, improving rendering performance and UI consistency; integrated third-party job listing and resume APIs for real-time data synchronization.

Worked in AI-powered resume parser in Python leveraging NLP techniques to extract and structure candidate data (skills, experience, education), significantly improving automation accuracy in candidate screening pipelines.

Designed RESTful APIs in Golang for user authentication, resume retrieval, and job listing updates; documented all endpoints via Swagger, reducing integration issues and improving cross-team API adoption.

Conducted comprehensive API testing using Postman (functional, performance, tests), ensuring reliability and uptime of critical RESTful services across the platform.

Designed and optimized MySQL schemas for user profiles, resume data, and job listings, ensuring efficient indexing, fast query performance, and reliable data retrieval under concurrent load.

Job Fair Tool | Golang ,React, Redux Toolkit, PostgreSQL, AWS, REST APIs, Git

Mar 2023 – Jan 2025 • Led the development of a scalable job fair platform using React and Golang, enabling real-time interactions between job

seekers and employers with a focus on performance and user experience.

Structured backend services around core domains (user, job, application, notifications) and developed key services in Golang, improving system clarity, enabling independent feature development, and supporting scalable API design.

Designed and optimized high-performance RESTful APIs using Golang and PostgreSQL, applying indexing, query optimization, and connection pooling to support high concurrency with low-latency responses.

Enhanced frontend performance using React, Redux Toolkit, and RTK Query, improving data fetching efficiency and reducing unnecessary re-renders.

Integrated AI-driven features such as personalized job recommendations and resume insights using external AI APIs to enhance user experience and relevance.

Education

Silver Jubilee College Bachelor of Commerce and Computers

Kurnool June 2019 – April 2022

Implemented a layered backend (handler → service → repository) with Snowflake IDs, report upserts enforced by a UNIQUE employee/time-window constraint, consistent typed HTTP errors, and async OpenAI security analysis decoupled from the upload response through background jobs.
Designed a hybrid AI scoring pipeline that combines deterministic URL/domain tagging (personal messaging, job-hunting, entertainment) with LLM-based risk scoring (risk level, risk score, structured findings[]), using prompts, JSON-mode responses, and server-side validation before persisting results.
Shipped a React (Vite) HR dashboard using MUI and TanStack Query, featuring employee and report views with S3-backed detail access, an AI risk panel with status polling and manual re-run, plus Docker Compose orchestration and a Windows collector deployment bundle (Task Scheduler, sqlite3).
